description: This file declares the interface for WiFi client-side hardware abstraction layer (HAL) functions related to WiFi station management, including getting and setting station network parameters such as SSID, MAC, radio index, and enabling/disabling stations.

methods.name: wifi_getSTANumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of WLAN station entries and outputs it via a pointer.

methods.name: wifi_getSTAName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a specific station identified by apIndex.

methods.name: wifi_getSTARadioIndex
methods.description: Gets the radio index associated with a given SSID index.

methods.name: wifi_getSTAMAC
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a station identified by ssidIndex.

methods.name: wifi_getSTABSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the BSSID of a station identified by ssidIndex.

methods.name: wifi_getSTASSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of a station identified by ssidIndex.

methods.name: wifi_getSTACredentials
methods.description: Retrieves the credentials (possibly password or security info) for a station identified by ssidIndex.

methods.name: wifi_getSTANetworks
methods.description: Gets the list of station networks for a given AP index, including network info and scan status.

methods.name: wifi_setSTANetworks
methods.description: Sets the list of station networks for a specified AP, potentially initiating a scan if specified.

methods.name: wifi_getSTAEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a station identified by ssidIndex is enabled.

methods.name: wifi_setSTAEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a station identified by ssidIndex.
